scripts.check: bun --bun run tsc --noEmit && bun --bun run --cwd apps/controller check
scripts.lint: bun run lint:eslint && bun run lint:anti-slop
scripts.lint:eslint: bun --bun run eslint apps packages tools '*.{ts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}'
scripts.lint:anti-slop: bun --bun run oxlint --report-unused-disable-directives-severity error apps packages tools eslint.config.ts oxlint.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.format: bun --bun run prettier --plugin prettier-plugin-svelte --write apps packages tools packaging examples .github '*.{ts,json}' README.md SECURITY.md API_CONTRACT.md DESIGN.md 'docs/*.md'
scripts.format:check: bun --bun run prettier --plugin prettier-plugin-svelte --check apps packages tools packaging examples .github '*.{ts,json}' README.md SECURITY.md API_CONTRACT.md DESIGN.md 'docs/*.md'
